title: Taiwan retail participation x recent-return interaction for 0050 realized variance
summary: 0050 residual-retail and margin-activity interaction proxies show mixed in-sample interaction evidence but no Harvey-strength OOS QLIKE improvement. Treat as an ETF-proxy pilot, not evidence on the full TWSE retail share.

method.target: day-t 0050 annualized r^2 and Parkinson range variance
method.baseline_features: lagged log RV 1/5/22, lagged 5-day return, lagged negative 5-day return
method.retail_proxy_1: residual retail share = 1 - institutional participation, clipped by valid 0050 volume and institutional ratio
method.retail_proxy_2: margin activity turnover = margin/short-sale buy+sell shares divided by 0050 volume
method.interaction: lagged retail z-score x lagged max(-past 5-day return, 0)
method.lookahead_guard: all retail, return, and HAR features are explicit .shift(1); target remains day t
method.inference: HAC OLS maxlags=5 for interaction coefficient; fixed train/OOS log-RV model with Patton QLIKE and DM h=1
method.multiple_testing: 4 headline target x proxy interaction tests; Bonferroni alpha=0.0125

limitations: Residual retail participation is inferred for 0050 only; it is not an official full-market retail-share series.
Local institutional and margin snapshots end in March 2026, so this does not include the latest 2026Q2 dates.
0050 ETF flow can reflect creation/redemption and institutional hedging mechanics, not only household retail trading.
Daily OHLC cannot identify intraday retail order imbalance or attention shocks.
This is an ETF-level pilot; stock-level cross-section could behave differently.

references.title: Chordia, Lin, Xiang (2025), Return Extrapolation and Volatility Expectations
references.use: Motivates recent-return extrapolation as a channel for volatility expectations.

references.title: Foucault, Sraer, Thesmar (2011), Individual Investors and Volatility
references.use: Motivates retail trading activity as a volatility channel.

references.title: Boehmer, Jones, Zhang, Zhang (2021), Tracking Retail Investor Activity
references.use: Shows retail activity can be proxied from public transaction patterns; this experiment uses a weaker Taiwan ETF residual proxy.
